title: Importing EEA AQ Data with {euroaq}
text: flexible data access, including asynchronous data access, three options, mirroring three options outlined https://eeadmz1-downloads-webapp.azurewebsites.net/content/documentation/How_To_Downloads.pdf. options control data imported (countries & cities), specific pollutants import, datasets origin. Two three also allow users specify start end date, well aggregation type. get_eea_parquet_files() download zip folder parquet files user-specified file, returning file path. get_eea_parquet_async() initiate construction zip folder parquet files background, returns URL zip file made available. suitable larger requests. file won’t exist straight away, one approach check URL periodically . get_eea_parquet_urls() return R character vector URLs individual parquet files can found. parquet file contains complete time series single sampling point, function ignores datetime aggregation type arguments. Note parquet files contain timezone-less ‘clock times’. described , hourly data UTC+01 daily data local time station.
code: get_eea_parquet_files(countries = "FR", file = "mydata.zip")  utils::unzip(zipfile = "mydata.zip", exdir = "parquets")  paths <- dir("parquets", recursive = TRUE, full.names = TRUE)  tables <- lapply(paths, arrow::read_parquet)  aqdata <- dplyr::bind_rows(tables) zipurl <- get_eea_parquet_async(countries = "FR")  # check every 20 seconds for up to an hour until the file is available for (i in 1:180) {   resp <- httr2::request(zipurl) |>     httr2::req_error(is_error = \(resp) FALSE) |>     httr2::req_perform(path = "mydata.zip")    if (httr2::resp_status(resp) != 404) {     break   }    Sys.sleep(20) }  utils::unzip(zipfile = "mydata.zip", exdir = "parquets")  paths <- dir("parquets", recursive = TRUE, full.names = TRUE)  tables <- lapply(paths, arrow::read_parquet)  aqdata <- dplyr::bind_rows(tables) urls <- get_eea_parquet_urls(countries = "FR", pollutants = "NO2")  tables <- lapply(urls, arrow::read_parquet)  aqdata <- dplyr::bind_rows(tables)

title: euroaq 0.3.0
text: Datetimes now handled correctly throughout euroaq, changes dates returned import_eea_monitoring() data returned functions datetime_start datetime_end arguments: import_eea_monitoring() now assigns correct timezone date date_end. EEA reports hourly variable data UTC+01 daily data local time station, previously station’s timezone applied data, sign offset inverted (e.g., “UTC+01” treated UTC-01). result also depended timezone user’s R session. single result contains several timezones, date date_end now displayed UTC, timezone column records timezone original data. POSIXct values datetime_start datetime_end now refer correct instant time. Previously, clock time sent API UTC. Note monitoring data reported UTC+01, whereas CAMS forecast rasters UTC, now handled accordingly. Date values datetime_end now include whole given day, consistent integer years. title: euroaq 0.3.0
text: Functions downloading files EEA now warn 600MB download limit reached. Previously, incomplete data returned without indication incomplete. Errors EEA API without error message (e.g., 404) now report status code description, rather failing unrelated error. Requests return data now handled gracefully: import_eea_monitoring() warns returns empty tibble usual columns. Previously, failed unrelated error. get_eea_parquet_urls() returns empty character vector, get_eea_country_city_spos() returns empty tibble. import_eea_raster() gives informative error. import_eea_monitoring() longer fails station metadata unavailable, either downloaded sampling points missing . Instead, warns returns data without site information (e.g., site, lat lng) sampling points. Station metadata also now downloaded monitoring data, monitoring data returned. import_eea_stations() now gives error class euroaq_stations_unavailable metadata downloaded, warns, rather fails, metadata can found country. get_eea_parquet_urls() now strips byte-order mark start API’s response, making robust. dynamic = TRUE get_eea_parquet_files() get_eea_parquet_async() now explicitly requests ‘dynamic’ method. Previously, API left choose method . import_eea_monitoring() now names pollutant variable column using import_eea_pollutants(), rather station metadata. means variable longer missing station metadata unavailable. import_eea_monitoring() longer drops sampling points outside cities cities = NULL. Previously, cities given countries passed API, excluded sampling point within city (e.g., roughly half sampling points France). empty list cities now passed, API treats “”. import_eea_monitoring() import_eea_stations() now delete files download extract read, rather leaving session’s temporary directory. import_eea_raster() deletes downloaded zip file, keeps extracted rasters read lazily terra. import_eea_raster() now also finds rasters .tif file extension, documentation now correctly states returns terra::SpatRaster rather tibble.
